title: 653. Design Excel Sum Formula

examples.explanation: Build a 3x3 sheet; set A1 to 2; get A1 is 2; sum A1+A2 into B1 gives 4 (A2 is 0); get B1 is 4.
A1=5 and B1=7, so the formula A1+B1 stored at A2 evaluates to 12.

hints: Model columns as 1-based numbers (A=1, B=2, ...); keep a value grid plus a formula map keyed by cell.
set writes the value and clears any formula on that cell; get evaluates live (following formulas recursively).
sum stores the token list as the cell formula (each token is a cell like B2 or a rectangle like A1:B2) and returns the evaluated total.
Only get and sum produce outputs, collected in call order into the int_array result.

Adaptation: this judge drives the sheet through runExcel(operations, args) with all arguments stringified; the constructor takes [height, widthCount] and set/get/sum take 1-based [row, col] plus values or formula tokens.
